texts: Pectus excavatum is linked with connective tissue disorders.
Up to two-thirds of children with Marfan's syndrome have pectus excavatum: C is the answer.
In Marfan's syndrome the aortic root also widens, and it is checked before any repair of the chest.
It also occurs in Ehlers-Danlos syndrome, and it is not associated with trisomy 18.
Patients with connective tissue disorders have a higher risk of recurrence after repair.
